chunks: Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a muhrim develops an abscess or a boil, then he may lance it and treat it with oil or fat.

key_terms.سَمْنٍ: fat or clarified butter used for treatment
key_terms.فَلْيَبُطَّهُ: let him lance or open it
key_terms.ٱلْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Is a muhrim allowed to treat an abscess or boil with oil or fat during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a muhrim who suffers from an abscess or boil. It permits opening the swelling and treating it with oil or fat, indicating allowance for necessary medical care during ihram.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2657 - Hisham ibn Salim narrated from Abu Abdullah (as), who said:
"If a Muhrim develops an abscess or a boil, he may lance it and treat it with oil or fat."
